entries.basis: Existing architecture selects the single package plus granular subpaths. Fourteen packed production probes verify core isolation, icon pruning, explicit CSS and grid/editor positive controls; root convenience traversal remains documented.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-A-18 Reconcile original `A-18`: Keep heavyweight modules out of basic-control dependency paths; decide which require separate subpaths versus separate packages. Historical status: open.

entries.basis: Editor-only module traversal is behind its granular component boundary; installation weight has been measured and a compatibility-preserving single-package choice versus separate core/editor packages is explicitly assessed. No requirement for optional editor installation is silently claimed or new package/API introduced.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-E-08 Reconcile original `E-08`: Put editor-only dependencies behind a granular import boundary and assess whether separate packages are required to avoid mandatory installation weight. Historical status: open.

limits: Dependency traversal/bundle behavior is distinct from package-manager installation. Single-package consumers still install editor dependencies and shared stylesheet. Prior fourteen-probe archive and later layout-only archive check retain their distinct inputs; no fresh performance, publication or release claim.
